subject.title: fix(msteams): add graphMediaFallback so group-chat file attachments reach the agent

question: Should this PR land as a narrow group-chat opt-in fallback, or should it be folded into the broader Microsoft Teams channel attachment repair before merge?
rationale: The PR adds operator-facing config and references the canonical channel attachment issue, while a separate proof-positive PR fixes the channel URL root causes without adding that config surface.

options.title: Narrow to group chats
options.body: Keep this PR focused on the live-proven group-chat behavior, update docs/tests/body wording, and leave channel attachment repair to the canonical channel fix path.

options.title: Fold in channel fixes
options.body: Add the team AAD group ID and channel reply URL changes before advertising channel support or closing the canonical issue.

options.title: Supersede with broader PR
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer reviewing the existing broader no-new-config channel attachment PR as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Narrow to group chats
recommendation.body: Keep this PR focused on the live-proven group-chat behavior, update docs/tests/body wording, and leave channel attachment repair to the canonical channel fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a Microsoft Teams config-surface and plugin-boundary product choice, and history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
